text:
maria: quick kickoff for CloudCo refkit: goal = terraform modules + one-click template + tiny demo by EOW. who takes what?
aj: I can scaffold the modules (network, compute, observability) + CI (tflint, tfsec, terraform validate, small terratest). will make inputs minimal.
devon: i'll own the instance/AMI matrix. CloudCo wants arm64 + accelerated GPU guidance. will include driver and kernel notes.
samir: i'll build the demo app that calls Redwood API and emits Prometheus metrics. add a smoke load script to reproduce latency and token cost.
elaine: i'll own marketplace packaging, quickstart doc, short demo clip, and partner submission checklist. will draft announcement copy too.
aj: sample README snippet to include:
```hcl
module "refkit_compute" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refkit.git//modules/compute"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "g5.2xlarge"
  image_id = var.image_id
  instance_count = 2
}
```
marketplace-bot: checklist:update listing requires docs, quickstart, terraform registry entry, automated smoke test, support_contact.
maria: action items assigned: aj=modules+CI, devon=AMI matrix, elaine=packaging+docs, samir=demo+dashboard. i'll open main tracking issue.
aj: plan to release modules v0.1.0 to our terraform registry with release notes (supported clouds, instance types, limitations).
devon: i'll post AMI doc tomorrow and tag aj for defaults and image IDs.
samir: will include a reproducible inference script (seed, batch, seq_len) and cost runbook.
elaine: i'll paste the marketplace page template here before submission for quick feedback.
maria: scheduling a short sync with CloudCo PM tomorrow 11am PT. who can join?
aj: joining.
devon: in.
samir: can join first 10m.
elaine: attending and will take notes.
maria: thanks all. ping updates here. :rocket:
